messages:
maria_cs: Quick note 99starting a micro-pilot for onboarding records that lack product_usage and owner. Plan: attempt automated enrich via VendorEnrich API, then route leftovers to a manual review queue (cs-curation-review). Want ops + infra sign-off before enabling a 4% deterministic sample.

olivia_cs_ops: Sounds good. How are we gating? We should limit to trial ARR > $300 and exclude any opted-out accounts. Also add a legal_hold exclusion.

kai_data: Proposed sampler: consistent_hash(account_id) % 100 < 4 so it's replayable. Add activity filter: events_last_7d >= 2 to avoid stale records. Also prefer timezone not null so owners are available during local hours.

devon_eng: Enrich endpoint can accept batches of 150 ids. We'll front it with a leaky bucket limiter and push failures to Kafka topic cs.curation.enrich.dead. Need a payload contract and idempotency key.

maria_cs: SQL draft (dry-run mode):

```sql
SELECT account_id
FROM crm.accounts
WHERE product_usage IS NULL
  AND trial_active = true
  AND (abs(hashtext(account_id)) % 100) < 4
  AND opt_out = false
  AND legal_hold = false
  AND events_last_7d >= 2;
```

kai_data: Minor nit: prefer murmurhash for distribution. I'll add the query to data-platform with a run_id prefix curation_pilot_202603. Also will emit metrics: candidate_count, enriched_success, enrich_error_rate, manual_queue_volume.

olivia_cs_ops: Who owns the manual queue? @sam_ops should own rotations and SLA. We need a 72h SLA for owner assignment during the pilot.

sam_ops: Happy to run the rotation for 2 weeks. I'll add a Slack shortcut to the cs-curation-review channel that creates an Asana task when claiming an item. SLA 72h acknowledged.

devon_eng: API contract: POST /v1/vendor_enrich {"account_ids": ["acct_1", ...], "run_id":"curation_pilot_202603"} returns {"accepted": int, "failed_ids": []}. We'll support retry-after headers on 429. Add header X-Idempotency-Key.

playbook-bot: Automation: curation-pilot-scheduler scheduled 09:30 UTC daily. dry_run=true for 48 hours. Notifications to #csops-monitoring.

maria_cs: I'll run manual verification on a stratified sample of 25 accounts after dry-run (check owner correctness, no PII leakage, fields: product_usage, primary_owner, last_active_ts).

devon_eng: I'll create a LaunchDarkly flag curation_pilot_enabled and wire it into the scheduler. Also set a temporary ingress rate cap of 180rps and a dead-letter monitor alert.

kai_data: I'll add alerts in DataDog for enrich_error_rate > 2% and manual_queue_size > 200. Also will track owner_assignment_latency histogram.

olivia_cs_ops: Add rollback steps in the wiki: flip LD flag off, cancel scheduler, purge pending enrich requests (dead-letter for audit). Also add contact list for legal & privacy for quick escalation.

maria_cs: I'll update the playbook doc (link will be posted) with SQL, API shape, run_id patterns, acceptance criteria, and rollback. Target go/no-go review Friday EOD.

sam_ops: I'll prepare the rotation roster and create the Asana template for claims.

maria_cs: Thanks — will post PR to #docs and a short summary in #eng-prod. Planning to evaluate metrics after 48h dry-run then enable 4% sample if smoke checks pass.
